claims.text: Amazon confirms all eight season-one episodes are available and refers to its final episode.
The eight episode titles are The End, The Target, The Head, The Ghouls, The Past, The Trap, The Radio and The Beginning.
The creators chose an independent story within the game world and emphasized its mixture of comedy and drama.
Nolan describes realizing the world in front of the camera to reduce necessary visual effects. Stuart Dryburgh, Howard Cummings, Amy Westcott and Jay Worth are named.
Lucy follows the golden rule; her actor connects that belief with her integrity through the finale.
The opening shows Cooper Howard with his daughter at a birthday party when nuclear disaster begins.
Lucy finds Hank held by Moldaver at the observatory. Norm discovers cryogenic Vault-Tec employees in Vault 31, including Hank.
Moldaver explains that Rose took the children to Shady Sands. Hank brought them back and destroyed the town. Rose became a ghoul.
The object in Wilzig’s head enables cold fusion. Moldaver needs Hank’s code to activate it.
Maximus frees Hank. Hank takes the power armour, knocks Maximus unconscious and escapes after the Ghoul confronts him.
Lucy kills her ghoulified mother and leaves with the Ghoul. Moldaver activates cold fusion; the Brotherhood finds Maximus and calls him a knight.
The final shot shows Hank heading toward New Vegas. The Ghoul’s family and Lucy’s next journey remain unresolved within season one.
